response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition: CLOSE_FP.** Confidence is 0.90. The proposal is recorded and awaits a human decision.

The three facts that drove it:
1. T-MM-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It re-quoted symmetric 386-lot bids and asks every 1–3 seconds. Cancel symmetry is 0.993, and each quote is only about 0.15× depth. No single order is large.
2. Feature (a) is absent: 433 of the 636 lots executed on its own bids came before any opposite-side trade, so the resting orders were working. Feature (b) is absent: the price moved −1 tick with no reversion, there were no market events, and the round trip of 3.3 ticks is ordinary spread income.
3. The only indicator that matched is the order-to-trade ratio, 15.9 against a typical 14.4.

The one thing that would change my mind is a large one-sided resting order. That would mean cancels on one side only, or an opposite-side fill at a price the quote had moved in the trader's favour, with reversion after the cancel.

The two prior closures on this trader (H-T-MM-01-01 and H-T-MM-01-02) point the same way. I did not rely on them. I checked today's tape on its own.
